verdict.rationale: Spline documents a public Code API, a JavaScript runtime library, that lets developers trigger actions and modify object properties of Spline scenes from their own code. However, it drives exported scenes rather than the product itself, and evidence states there is no REST API or machine-readable spec, which the OpenAPI probe 404s confirm. missing for 10: a REST/HTTP API for driving the editor, files, or account; a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI); a hosted API reference or test environment; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It enables you to trigger actions, modify object properties, and create dynamic, responsive 3D environments directly from your existing code and user interface.
The Code API allows you to seamlessly integrate interactive 3D experiences into your projects, offering greater control and customization.
There is no REST API, no machine-readable spec, no hosted reference or runner
